en: <1><2>When it is not a consumer relationship, does the law still protect you?</2><3><4>Governed Enjoyment Intangible Object (GEIO)</4>. The civil genus of which the IOC is the consumer-law species, for those who depend on a platform without being consumers.</3></1>

<1><2>If the platform leaves, how much time does it owe you?</2><3><4>Autometry</4>. The principle that measures the supplier's duties by the choices it made itself, starting with the shutdown of the service.</3></1>
